thesis_summary.thesis: Evolve Royalties Ltd. is a Canadian junior royalty company listed on the CSE that collects cash from net profits interests and net smelter return royalties on copper, tin, and lithium projects without operating mines. **[Fact]** The portfolio spans 14 assets anchored by a 0.51% net profits interest on Teck's Highland Valley Copper mine, a 5% copper NSR on a portion of Hudbay's Copper Mountain mine, a sliding-scale tin gross-revenue royalty on Namibia's Uis mine, and a C$0.75 per tonne royalty on Eldorado Gold's McIlvenna Bay project (`EVR/presentations-and-media/corporate-presentation-2026-02.pdf`; `EVR/official-reports/news-release-2026-06-01-ytd-royalty-payments.txt`). **[Fact]** The company was formed by the Nomad Royalty team (sold to Sandstorm Gold for US$755 million in 2022) and listed on the CSE on December 17, 2025 after a reverse takeover with Voyageur Minerals Explorers Corp. **[Fact]** From January 1 through June 1, 2026, Evolve received C$2.70 million in royalty payments on roughly 55 million pro-forma shares outstanding.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: The market may treat Evolve as a thinly traded CSE micro-cap and miss the inflection from one cash-flowing royalty at year-start toward four by year-end 2026. **[Inference]** At C$2.80 the stock trades near a 34% discount to the roughly C$4.26 per share net asset value implied by peer price-to-NAV multiples in the February 2026 corporate presentation, while Royalty King screen work flagged Evolve as the only junior royalty name near 0.75 times NAV versus peers at 1.0 to 1.7 times **[PENDING APPROVAL]**. **[Inference]** CSE listing friction, small float, and no dividend yet may exclude yield-screen buyers even as Uis tin and Highland Valley copper payments accelerate with elevated commodity prices.
